title: Regions (record/views/index/regions.json)
description: Decision 0058 rule 4, built by themes.js: one entry for each of the 10 board regions, always all ten, in the region table's order. The stories are the surviving stories of index/web.json `threads`; a story counts in every region its countries fall in, so the counts add up to more than the story count. `state`: 'no stories' (none in the region), 'no links judged' (stories, but no judged link has an end in the region), 'links' (at least one judged pair has one end in the region; a pair is not a theme, so `themeIds` can be empty). `scored`: the region's stories with a tier. `highTier`: those with tier high. `linked`: its stories that are an end of any judged pair, in a theme or not. `themeIds`: the themes with a story in the region, sorted.
